name: Asclepiodotus
bio: Asclepiodotus is one of the epigrammatists whose short poems were gathered in the Greek Anthology. His date is not known.
Mackail's Select Epigrams (1890) prints one of his epigrams, on Memnon and Achilles.

poems.title: Memnon and Achilles (Mackail)
poems.author: Asclepiodotus
poems.collection: Select Epigrams from the Greek Anthology (1890)
poems.text: Know, O Thetis of the sea, that Memnon yet lives and cries aloud, warmed by his mother's torch, in Egypt beneath Libyan brows, where the running Nile severs fair-portalled Thebes; but Achilles, the insatiate of battle, utters no voice either on the Trojan plain or in Thessaly.
